title: FC Seoul crowned K League 1 champions
caption:
FC Seoul has secured the K League 1 title for the first time in a decade, wrapping up the championship five rounds early. A 1-1 result against Gangwon FC combined with a draw for rivals Ulsan HD gave Seoul an uncatchable 16-point cushion.
